notes: UAE AI-powered SpaceTech company with satellite imaging and geospatial AI. FY2025 revenue $577M (-8% YoY). Space Services (satellites) and Smart Solutions (AI analytics) segments.

gov_contract_notes: Dutch and EU government strategic asset. ASML lithography machines are critical NATO and allied semiconductor supply chain infrastructure. EU and Dutch government involved in export control decisions.
regulatory_actions: Dutch government blocked ASML from exporting advanced EUV machines to China (2023, acting on US pressure). US-Dutch diplomatic negotiations over export controls ongoing. ASML faces pressure from China which is a significant revenue source.
notes: World's only manufacturer of EUV lithography machines — the critical chokepoint for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. FY2025 revenue ~$37B, net income ~$10.4B. Geopolitical pressure point in US-China chip war.

gov_contract_notes: UK, EU, and Australian government legal and scientific database contracts. LexisNexis used by law enforcement, courts, and intelligence agencies globally. No military contracts known.
regulatory_actions: EU and US scrutiny over use of LexisNexis data by US immigration enforcement (ICE). GDPR compliance obligations across European data products. Academic publishing monopoly concerns in EU.
notes: Information analytics and AI platform across legal (LexisNexis), scientific (Elsevier), risk, and exhibitions. FY2025 revenue ~$12.1B (+7% underlying), net income ~$2.72B. AI tools deeply embedded across product portfolio.
